hero.intro: Sustainable Women's Day gifts for every woman on your team: soya wax candles, cork desk sets and dry fruit boxes, branded with your logo and a message from leadership.

about.title: A thank-you that goes beyond a greeting.
about.text: Women's Day is one of the few occasions where companies gift the whole team on the same day. A useful, plastic-free gift with a personal note lands better than a generic hamper.
